definition: Two-stage pipeline: (1) compute engineered spatial/kinematic features from tracked pose keypoints, (2) train supervised ensemble classifiers on labeled behavior data

fidelity_items.requirement: Frame-level (x, y, p) coordinates for multiple body keypoints per animal
fidelity_items.notes: 8 keypoints x 3 coords x 2 mice from SimBA sample project

fidelity_items.requirement: Within-animal distances, between-animal distances, body angles, polygon areas
fidelity_items.notes: Nose-to-tail, width, ear distance, centroid distance, nose-to-nose, cross distances, polygon areas via convex hull
16 movement channels (8 body parts x 2 mice)

fidelity_items.requirement: Rolling window statistics (means, stds) across multiple timescales
fidelity_items.notes: Windows of 2, 5, 6, 7, 10, 15 frames for key distances and total movement

fidelity_items.requirement: Ensemble tree methods (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting) with class weighting
fidelity_items.notes: RF: 200 trees, max_depth=15; GB: 200 estimators, lr=0.05, max_depth=5; both class_weight='balanced'

fidelity_items.requirement: Stratified split to preserve class proportions
Accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC AUC, PR AUC, confusion matrices

fidelity_items.notes: Top-20 features exported per classifier-behavior combination

deviations.reason: Focus on core spatial/kinematic/temporal features that are most interpretable and auditable. Additional features (percentile ranks, deviation statistics, tortuosity) omitted for transparency.
Faithful methodological reproduction using standard ML libraries for full transparency and auditability.
